name: 大口径霰弹枪
description: 弹射物。选择正方向，对4格内首个敌人造成伤害：距离1/2/3/4格时分别造成2/1.5/1/0.5倍伤害。
code: function executeSkill(context) { var source = context.piece; var targetPosition = selectTarget({ type: 'grid', range: 4, filter: 'all' }); if (!targetPosition || targetPosition.needsTargetSelection) return targetPosition; var dx = targetPosition.x - source.x; var dy = targetPosition.y - source.y; if ((dx !== 0 && dy !== 0) || (dx === 0 && dy === 0)) return { success: false, message: '请选择正方向' }; var direction = { x: dx === 0 ? 0 : (dx > 0 ? 1 : -1), y: dy === 0 ? 0 : (dy > 0 ? 1 : -1) }; var events = traceProjectile({ x: source.x, y: source.y }, direction, { excludePieceId: source.instanceId, maxDistance: 4 }); for (var i = 0; i < events.length; i++) { var event = events[i]; if (event.type === 'piece') { if (arePlayersAllied(battle, event.piece.ownerPlayerId, source.ownerPlayerId)) return { success: true, message: source.name + '的大口径霰弹枪被友方棋子阻挡' }; var multipliers = { 1: 2, 2: 1.5, 3: 1, 4: 0.5 }; var multiplier = multipliers[event.distance] || 0.5; var damage = Math.floor(source.attack * multiplier); var result = dealDamage(source, event.piece, damage, 'physical', battle, context.skill.id); return { success: true, message: source.name + '使用大口径霰弹枪命中' + event.piece.name + '，造成' + (result.damage || 0) + '点伤害' }; } if (event.type === 'terrain' && event.blocksProjectile) return { success: true, message: source.name + '的大口径霰弹枪被地形阻挡' }; } return { success: true, message: source.name + '的大口径霰弹枪未命中敌人' }; }
previewCode: function calculatePreview(piece) { return { description: '弹射物。选择正方向，对首个敌人（4）造成伤害，对距离1/2/3/4格敌人造成2/1.5/1/0.5倍伤害。', expectedValues: { damageByDistance: [Math.floor(piece.attack * 2), Math.floor(piece.attack * 1.5), piece.attack, Math.floor(piece.attack * 0.5)] } }; }
